title: The wake: feeding, turning, rising, read frame by frame from the clip

phases.label: Feeding
phases.note: Head down over the body on the floor while the hunter walks up behind it.

phases.label: Turning
phases.note: The head lifts and swings round towards the hunter; the eyes catch the light.

phases.label: Rising
phases.note: It pushes up off the floor and rears to its full height. The run ends a few frames later.

events.label: the frame shown at the top of the page

note: Boundaries are read by eye, one frame at a time. Each clip frame is one frame the renderer presented; the run was slower than the real game, so read the order of events from the clip, not their duration.

sources.record: media review: clinic beast wake clip (2026-11-14)
sources.note: Local Paleblood run of 2026-11-13: main at this revision with PRs #958 and #975 applied (both merged since).
